name: Cyclizine
metabolism: Cyclizine is well absorbed from the gastrointestinal tract; after oral administration effects develop within 30 minutes, are maximal within 1-2 hours and last 4-6 hours. A single 50 mg oral dose in healthy adult volunteers gave a peak plasma concentration of about 70 ng/mL at about two hours, with a plasma elimination half-life of about 20 hours. The N-demethylated derivative norcyclizine is a metabolite (with little H1-antihistaminic activity compared with cyclizine, a half-life of about 20 hours, and wide tissue distribution). In one adult male volunteer, urine collected over 24 hours after a single 50 mg dose contained less than 1% of the dose.
summary: Cyclizine is an antihistamine and anticholinergic medication used to treat and prevent nausea, vomiting, and dizziness, including motion sickness and vertigo.
